name: opencode-suite
body: The installed opencode tool suite (`opencode-suite/`, embedded into the apg binary and installed by `apg init` into `~/.opencode/`): the curated read/write tools an agent calls (`apg_file_path`, `apg_file_units`, `apg_hunk`, …), their shared plumbing in `opencode-suite/lib/apg.ts`, and the tool-boundary path resolution. It is the agent-facing layer of the apg system — the consumer of the graph's stored identities — and is a separate deliverable from the Rust `apg` binary modelled by solution.container.scanner-cli.
